scope: Web translation-editor UX; existing source, draft, review and approval rules retained

checks: original and English target are clearly named
empty translation has a clear status
unsupported assembly has no generation action
target stays English when browsing Portuguese
draft is saved and original remains displayed
previous approval is visible while editing
saved replacement retains the prior approval
approval is disabled until edits are saved
explicit reload preserves the editing buffer
reviewed retry saves against latest token
unconfirmed source has a visible prompt
unsaved text survives target language navigation
source correction labels original and requires draft review
reviewed material translation can be approved
pinned material assistance saves a draft without approval
translation editor fits a narrow pane
proposal gaps are visible beside the draft
P manual description is shown consistently
P material assignment replaces manual text
assigned P has no independent text editor
cleared description does not fall back to legacy name
generic S description coexists with mass controls
structured S description is read only

limits: Browser mutations exercised disposable SQLite/HTTP fixtures only; no production translations were created.
Unsaved buffers live only in the current browser session and clear on sign-out; saving a draft persists text.
Other open clients require refresh/reopen to show new approvals; native UI and frozen TechDraw tables retain their existing explicit update rules.
This change introduces no project-wide viewing-language setting or schema migration.
publication: Local working tree only; not committed or pushed
